{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVlzVyc8AAAABeAWGgA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BqjeczhHhmfE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bqjec", "number": 20, "title": "feat: implement pure v2 patch parsing, validation, and preview planning", "body": "## Problem

[Issue #16](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/issues/16) established Cognix's move toward a small set of general-purpose coding tools. [Issue #18](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/issues/18) completed roadmap milestone 1 by extracting shared approval and evidence helpers.

The next dependency is **milestone 2** of [docs/tool-architecture.md](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/docs/tool-architecture.md#ordered-implementation-roadmap): safely parse, validate, and plan the proposed versioned multi-file patch contract **before** attempting any filesystem mutation. Currently, `apply_patch` still supports only a unique-span edit to one previously read file, while `create_file` is separate.

## Expected outcome

Implement an internal, testable **pure/side-effect-free v2 patch parser and planner** for the versioned structured operation format in [the architecture decision](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/docs/tool-architecture.md#general-patch-contract).

Example *proposed v2 input* (not a valid call to today's model-facing tool):

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "changes": [
    {"op": "add", "path": "src/widget/mod.rs", "content": "pub fn value() -> u32 { 1 }\n"},
    {"op": "update", "path": "src/lib.rs", "sha256": "<64-character hash from read_file>", "edits": [{"old_text": "mod old;", "new_text": "mod widget;"}]},
    {"op": "delete", "path": "tests/obsolete.rs", "sha256": "<64-character hash from read_file>"},
    {"op": "move", "path": "src/old.rs", "to": "src/widget/value.rs", "sha256": "<64-character hash from read_file>", "edits": []}
  ]
}
```

The parser should return typed validated intent. A separate **read-only preflight/planning layer** should inspect the anchored project filesystem safely, check expected hashes/identities and feasibility, and return a deterministic immutable plan and a bounded, sanitized human-readable approval preview. It must not create directories, write staging files, change destination files, or otherwise perform target mutations.

This issue **does not execute or expose v2 patches**. Its output is an implementation-ready input and reviewed plan for milestone 3's descriptor-relative executor.

### Scope boundaries

- **No runtime mutation, `linkat` publication, deletion, rename, or directory creation** as part of v2 planning.
- **No change to existing model-facing tool schemas**, agent dispatch, `apply_patch` v1, `create_file`, `run_command`, CLI flags, default approvals, or current sandbox permissions.
- No v2 tool advertisement/model trials, `exec_command` permission expansion, migration of existing sessions, or auto-rollback.
- Reuse the [shared action lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/docs/implementation.md#shared-action-lifecycle) without a parallel runtime or speculative plugin framework.
- A plan is **not** authorization to mutate; milestone 3 must independently revalidate it after explicit consent and at commit time.

## Context and reproduction

- Latest `main` inspected: `8cefa94c247eece385d637116bacaac79b153518`.
- Prerequisite: [milestone 1 / Issue #18](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/issues/18), closed via [PR #19](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/pull/19).
- Canonical future contract: [docs/tool-architecture.md](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/docs/tool-architecture.md), including **Format choice**, **Matching, paths and bounds**, **Approval, publication and partial success**, and **Ordered implementation roadmap**.
- Current implementation: [`src/schema.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/src/schema.rs), [`src/runtime.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/src/runtime.rs), [`src/action.rs`](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/src/action.rs), and [`docs/implementation.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/cognix/blob/main/docs/implementation.md).
- No user-facing reproduction is expected yet; this is an internal prerequisite for v2 execution.

## Mandatory pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] **AC1 — Closed, typed v2 contract:** Parse only `{version: 2, changes: [...]}` with exactly the specified fields for `add`, `update`, `delete`, and `move`, and closed nested `{old_text,new_text}` edits. Reject missing/extra fields, wrong types, unknown ops/versions, malformed SHA-256 (exactly 64 lowercase hex chars), empty batches, bad edit shapes and oversized JSON without mutation. Distinguish parser errors with actionable structured reasons.
- [ ] **AC2 — Complete limits and path validation:** Enforce the decided ceilings (8 changes, 16 edits/source, 64 KiB/source or resulting file, 256 KiB total resulting content, 1 MiB arguments, 4,096-byte paths, 32 components/path, 32 planned new directories). Reject absolute/empty/trailing-slash paths, empty or `.`/`..` components, NULs, case-insensitive `.git`, invalid UTF-8 text or NUL content, and disallowed no-op/ambiguous/overlapping edits. Apply nonoverlapping matches against *original bytes* simultaneously, without fuzzy matching or newline normalization.
- [ ] **AC3 — Conflicts and dependencies:** Preflight **all** changes together and reject duplicate/aliasing source and destination paths, case-insensitive filesystem collisions, move cycles/swaps/case-only moves, file-directory prefix collisions, and a change depending on another change's output. Plan shared missing parent directories for adds/moves only, deduplicated in ancestor-first order; never create them in this milestone. Preserve existing-source read/hash requirements and destination-absence expectations. Test filesystem-sensitive aliases on actual host volume semantics, not only string equality.
- [ ] **AC4 — Read-only filesystem and metadata preflight:** Use the existing anchored-root, descriptor-relative, no-symlink traversal and safe regular-file checks for planning. Validate source identity and hash against a prior in-session read, destination absence (without following symlinks), existing parent identities, and creation feasibility. Detect unsupported special files, multiple hard links, special mode bits, ACL/xattr metadata where required by the v2 decision; **fail closed** when safe metadata detection cannot be established. Record identities, expected states, and new-parent plans for milestone 3 to recheck; no promise of race-free execution solely from preflight.
- [ ] **AC5 — Immutable, reviewable plan:** Return an ordered plan with exact operations, source/destination, relevant before/after bytes/hashes and existence, intended parent creations, byte counts, expected identities, and explicit constraints. Generate deterministic, bounded and terminal-sanitized add/update/delete/move previews, including move-with-edit diffs and every affected path/directory. Clearly mark truncated content and make the complete escaped plan inspectable in a manner consistent with the architecture decision, without dropping any paths from the summary. Preparation never seeks approval or commits changes.
- [ ] **AC6 — No side effects, legacy compatibility:** Verify with before/after project snapshots (including directories and hidden names) and negative/error tests that successful and failed preflight creates no file, directory, staging file, or metadata change. Existing five tool schemas, CLI behavior, action approvals, evidence, and sandbox rules remain unchanged. Planner output is internal only; v2 cannot be executed or advertised by the agent until a later milestone.
- [ ] **AC7 — Deterministic and real-filesystem regression coverage:** Add golden valid/mixed add-update-delete-move plans and previews; malformed and boundary-value tests; stale/changed inode/hash; dangling symlinks and symlinked parents; hard-linked files; missing parents; race/identity changes between inspections; file/directory and case/Unicode alias conflicts; ACL/xattr checks where supported. On supported macOS run the applicable existing runtime/agent/CLI and sandbox regressions, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`, documentation checker and whitespace checks. Report actual evidence and skipped checks, not assumed results.
- [ ] **AC8 — Documentation and milestone boundary:** Document new internal parser/planner interfaces, the plan/preview output, assumptions and supported limits; update `docs/implementation.md` or a focused developer document and keep the decision/README clear that v2 is **not yet available to models**. State concrete inputs/constraints the milestone 3 executor must revalidate after approval and before each mutation.

## Validation already performed

**Pass (repository inspection):** Confirmed latest `main`, completed milestone 1 (Issue #18 / PR #19), the architecture roadmap, Issue template and development-flow requirements; no existing milestone 2 Issue was found.

**Not run:** Parser/planner implementation, automated tests, real macOS tests, formatting/lint/build. These are for the implementation PR, not Issue creation.

## Optional validation

Independently review preview readability for a multi-file change and use property-based/fuzz tests to look for parser, overlap or alias bugs if useful. Real local Ollama model evaluations are scheduled for milestone 4, not a gate for this non-advertised parser.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.
